title: A fixed top margin under the header distance leaves the strip at the header distance; the body overprints it
source: Letter, pgMar top -720 (fixed 36pt), header 1440, three Calibri 11 header lines, page break after the first body line; Word for Mac PDF: header lines 72.05 / 85.49 / 98.93 and body 36.05 on both pages

cases.note: first-page edge strip; guards the strip page position; gen draws strip text 1.1pt low (strip chrome)
fixed margin ignores the header; gen 38.33: canvas body top under a fixed margin sits 1-2pt low
gap strip: not pinned to the 36pt body top; guards the strip page position; gen draws strip text 1.1pt low (strip chrome)
gen 37.13: canvas body top under a fixed margin sits 1-2pt low
